title: Vishwaroopam 2
desc: Wisam Ahmad Kashmiri, a RAW agent, tries to prevent a terrorist organisation from executing a deadly mission against three countries.

title: Kalyana Vaibhogam
desc: A man with strong traditional values falls in love with a woman, and they decide to get married, until the groom and the bride's father have a difference of opinion about marriage.

title: Velainu Vandhutta Vellaikaaran
desc: A minister on his deathbed reveals to an MLA the whereabouts of billions in cash that he has stashed away. However, the minister's relatives are vexed when the MLA loses his memory in an accident.

desc: Five grief-stricken women team up with 'Pencil', a crime novelist, to avenge the death of a man with whom they share a familial relation.

desc: Lieutenant Colonel Geetha Rani implements different plans to reform an undisciplined government school. However, she faces numerous challenges in her way, including a corrupt MLA.

desc: Guna kidnaps Eeswaran, brother of a minister, for orchestrating violence among students. However, Eeswaran escapes and trails after Guna to exact his revenge.

desc: Arjun and Anu fall in love with each other on a train journey. When Anu's father learns about their relationship, he remembers that he shares an unpleasant history with Arjun's father.

title: Amara Kaviyam
desc: Karthika and Jeeva, two college-going students, fall in love with each other but are forced to separate by their families. However, when they try to reunite, tragedy strikes.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A compilation of catchy and entertaining popular songs composed by famed artists and musicians from varied Tamil movies.

title: Mudinja Vazhu
desc: Seven young contestants take part in a reality TV show. They spend a week inside a haunted house and soon witness paranormal activities around them.

title: Velaikkaran
desc: Arivazhagan, a slum dweller, works in a large food company. However, when he realises that they adulterate the food, he strives to fight them.

title: Kadavul Irukaan Kumaru
desc: Kumar and his friend decide to celebrate the former's bachelor's party before his wedding. However, chaos ensues when the duo are caught by the police for carrying alcohol.

title: Oh Manapenne

title: Veerabali
desc: A happy-go-lucky man is forced to adopt violent means to avenge his parents' ruthless murders. So, with the help of his love, he sets out to punish the culprits.

title: Jigarthanda
desc: A budding director tries to research a merciless gangster for making a film on gangsterism. But his secret attempts to conduct the research fail when he gets caught for snooping.
